|combos=* [[Ghhhk]] + [[Imperial Holotable]] + [[Mosep]] [[Mosep]] should be one of the prime force drain members, as the loss will come straight from the Light Side Reserve Deck.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Ghhhk (GEMP ID 2_132, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), attributes the two strategy recommendations to combinations with Imperial Holotable and Mosep, and with Sunsdown and Defel. These are strategy recommendations, not original printed text or a requirement that Mosep occupy a holosite. For the separate damage-cancellation ruling, see [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 144, Ghhhk: cards incapable of being forfeited are ignored. Decipher's [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Glossary Version 2.0] (November 1998), p. 65, clarifies the original battle-damage function; its entry is not marked Errata, and p. 2 applies clarified gameplay to all versions. Preserved data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Ghhhk Scomp: Ghhhk].</ref>
* [[Ghhhk]] + [[Sunsdown]] + [[Defel]] [[Defel]] under 'night time conditions' fits the theme of this deck perfectly, as he can avoid combat, thus saving the use of the [[Ghhhk]], and still be there for the counter attack.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Ghhhk (Revised)]] (September 1998).
